name: The Crimson Veil
overview: On the eve of their forced marriages, Ye Hongzhuang and Jing Xiuyi survive an assassination attempt and secretly exchange identities. Disguised as Jing Xiuyi, Ye Hongzhuang marries into Prince Si Chen’s household to uncover a hidden conspiracy, only to be swept into a deadly clash of power, betrayal, and self-sacrificing love.
